detailed_descriptions.en: Going East! add-on expands the original Euro Truck Simulator 2 map with new destinations for cargo delivery across Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary. Key Features: Over 20 hours of driving to explore all the new areas in the game world 15 new cities including Warsaw, Krakow, Ostrava, Budapest, Kosice and more Many kilometers of challenging narrow roads, mountain passes, and roads under repair to test your driving skill

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Going East! add-on expands the original Euro Truck Simulator 2 map with new destinations for cargo delivery across Poland, Czech Republic, Slovakia, and Hungary.

Key Features:

  • Over 20 hours of driving to explore all the new areas in the game world
  • 15 new cities including Warsaw, Krakow, Ostrava, Budapest, Kosice and more
  • Many kilometers of challenging narrow roads, mountain passes, and roads under repair to test your driving skill
